scope: Reuse pinned public FramelessDialog/StandardTitleBar for common player popovers and seven condition-reader families plus direct fixed battle. Preserve original QWidget panels, source admission, callbacks, refresh and close protection. Native resize, title drag and themed close handled by mature external library.
acceptance: Real Windows dialogs: frame removed, common title/control, min/max absent, original source/scene selection preserved, close normal/ignored/suspended and child cleanup, native owned edge hit-tests and scaling; actual window update.
limits: Other raw dialogs, actual game/cross-monitor, complete video and all P3/P2/P1 incomplete. No claim to outside floating close parity yet.
